picks.question: Will the unemployment rate (U-3) be above 4.1% in October?
picks.why: An unemployment rate above 4.1% would signal a cooling labor market, shaping Fed policy and wage growth expectations.

picks.question: Will inflation reach more than 4.5% in 2026?
picks.why: Inflation above 4.5% would erode real incomes and likely force tighter monetary policy, raising borrowing costs economy-wide.

picks.question: Billionaire one-time wealth tax passes in California election 2026?
picks.why: A state-level wealth tax would test whether taxing billionaires' assets is workable, and whether capital and residents move elsewhere.

picks.question: Strait of Hormuz traffic returns to normal by December 31?
picks.why: About a fifth of global oil passes through Hormuz, so its disruption directly affects energy prices, inflation, and shipping costs.

picks.question: Will an AI lab announce another Millennium Prize solution by December 31, 2027?
picks.why: An AI solving a Millennium Prize Problem would mark a major leap in machine reasoning, with implications for research productivity.

picks.question: Will OpenAI’s market cap be $1.5T or greater at market close on IPO day by December 31, 2027?
picks.why: OpenAI's IPO valuation will show how much public investors are willing to pay for AI's expected future profits.
